messages:
maya: Quick design review — putting up a couple notes about the inline switch used in table rows. Alignment feels off when rows wrap, and screen reader text is terse.

devin: can you drop a screenshot? I think the switch baseline is shifted by 2px compared to text.

maya: attached (not in JSON) but imagine row with 3-line description — switch sits vertically centered, which pushes content. Also noticed toast flashes when toggling multiple switches rapidly.

priya: agree on the a11y part — the current aria-label is just "toggle" which is ambiguous. Suggest `aria-label="Enable routing for dataset X"` or use `aria-labelledby` pointing to the row title.

alex: +1 on using aria-labelledby. For ambiguous rows we can fallback to `aria-label="toggle setting"` but ideally compute a contextual label.

devin: implementation note: the switch is inside a flex container with `align-items: center`. When description wraps, the switch stays centered which looks misaligned with the primary label. If we change to `align-items: flex-start` it lines up, but we need to bump vertical padding.

maya: can we try `align-items: flex-start` and keep the same visual center by adding `padding-top: var(--space-1)` to the label? quick mock:
```
.row { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap: var(--space-4); }
.row__label { padding-top: var(--space-1); }
```

sasha: That seems fine. One more nit: when the row collapses (table responsive collapse) the switch moves under the title and then toast z-index makes it appear behind the sticky header. Need to fix toast stacking.

priya: we should check toast stacking order. Console uses `--z-toast: 600` and header is `--z-header: 700`. If toast should overlay header on quick actions, maybe raise to 800, but that might hide modals. We need defined layering rules.

alex: proposed layering for quick transient toasts: header (700), toast (750), modal backdrop (800), modal (900). But that would put modal behind toast. So better: header 700, modal-backdrop 750, modal 800, toast 850. Toast on top of modal seems wrong. Hmm.

devin: to avoid modal conflicts, we can scope toasts inside the app shell container so they never overlap global modals. Or use `aria-live` region anchored to the app area. For sticky header overlap specifically, increase toast z-index to 720, still under modals.

maya: agreed — set `--z-toast: 720` for now. Also we should add a small delay debounce when toggling multiple switches to prevent toast spam: 300ms coalesce into one toast summary like "3 changes saved".

priya: love the summary toast idea. Also copy tweak: instead of "Saved" use "Updates saved" for clarity.

sasha: accessibility test item: keyboard navigation into the switch when row is focused should be `Tab` to the switch, Enter/Space toggles. Current focus ring disappears because `outline: none` was added in a token override. Please revert.

maya: noted. I'll add tasks: 1) try flex-start + label padding mock, 2) update aria to `aria-labelledby` fallback to contextual label, 3) set `--z-toast: 720` and debounce toasts, 4) revert focus outline token for switches, 5) copy change to "Updates saved" and implement coalesced summary toast.

devin: pinging @design-bot to create a small RFC PR with the CSS and a11y updates.

design-bot: RFC created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design/pull/312 — includes CSS tweak, aria-labelledby example, and toast debounce util. Please review. :rocket:

maya: thanks — I'll review the PR and drop visual mocks. If anyone wants to try alternate spacing tokens, try `--space-1` -> `var(--space-2)` in label padding and comment in the PR.

alex: quick note for docs: add a small section in components/switches about usage inside tables and responsive collapse behavior.

priya: added to docs backlog. ok to close this thread after PR review?

maya: yep. closing after PR is merged. :slightly_smiling_face:
